outcome: Maternal outcomes (pregnancy-induced hypertension, mode of delivery, instrumental deliveries, postpartum hemorrhage)
Perinatal outcomes (birth weight, large-for-date babies, neonatal hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, congenital malformations)
cohort: 170 women with GDM and 191 women without GDM
finding: Adequate treatment of GDM with diet, oral hypoglycemic agents, or insulin to achieve euglycemia can achieve near-normal maternal and neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not different between women with and without GDM.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was significantly higher in the GDM group (2848 ± 539 g) than in the control group (2707 ± 641 g)
